1: The fear of the LORD is reverent awe that leads to trust and obedience, and the beginning of wisdom.
2: The realm of the dead, the grave.
Loyal, covenant love that keeps its promises; translated lovingkindness, mercy or steadfast love, and one of the great words of the Psalms.
Rescue and deliverance; it shares its root with the names Joshua and Jesus.
3: To be firm, and so to trust; the root of the word amen. Abraham believed the LORD and it was counted to him as righteousness.
To comfort, or to change course out of compassion: 'Comfort, comfort my people'.
4: Merciful and compassionate, the first quality God names when he describes himself to Moses.
Literally 'long of nostrils': slow to grow hot with anger.
